input.prompt:
Draft a complete reply for the following Gmail conversation in plain text only. Use only the thread messages below to understand the conversation history. The thread messages are chronological; the newest thread message is the current/latest email. Mentally convert them into: Current message with sender/content, then Previous messages as numbered datetime | sender | action lines. Greet first if appropriate with hi/hello/dear, then respond to the latest message. Close naturally with regards, best wishes, or another suitable closing when appropriate. Do not add facts that are not present in the message, thread, summary, or user intent. Use Summary_JSON as helpful context only, but prefer the actual message/thread if they differ. Write a fuller reply body, not an overly compact one-liner. Address every question, request, date, requirement, constraint, or next step in the message that needs a response. Follow User_reply_intent closely; if the intent is empty, draft a neutral helpful reply that fits the latest/current message and covers the relevant details. Respond to the latest sender and latest ask, while respecting dates, cancellations, scheduling context, and earlier thread details. Do not invent availability, promises, attachments, payments, project details, or facts. If information is missing, ask a clear clarification instead of making it up. Return only the reply body. Do not return JSON, labels, reasoning, markdown, or tool calls.

From: a@b.com
To: 
Subject: 
EMAIL_THREAD_START
Current message:
datetime: unknown date
sender: a@b.com
content: Please review the attached notes.
EMAIL_THREAD_END
User_reply_intent: Say I will review it today.
